280472207.description: This listing includes three vintage glass insulators marked 'WHITALL TATUM No 1'. Manufactured by the Whitall Tatum company, these insulators were used for telegraph and power lines during the early to mid-20th century. The glass ranges from clear to slightly smoky in color. Each insulator measures approximately 3-4 inches in height. The items are in good vintage condition with surface wear and dirt consistent with age and outdoor use. No major cracks or chips are visible. Each piece features embossed manufacturer details on the base.
